title: Inlet Beach "Barefoot Blue Main House" 98 N. Winston Lane
h1: Inlet Beach "Barefoot Blue Main House" 98 N. Winston Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Private pool - Short bike ride to the beach- Short walk to Rosemary Beach - Steps away from local shopping and dining in Rosemary Beach- Flat-screen TVs in every bedroom- Multiple balconies- Gas grill- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: This Barefoot Blue Cottage (formally Villa Cayman) is a professionally decorated, 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home boasting an open-concept layout and coastal, contemporary decor. It's located in Inlet Beach, just a short walk from the upscale boutiques and restaurants at Rosemary Beach and 30Avenue. The home has access to its own pool for those who prefer to sunbathe on vacation. As you enter the home, you'll find a cheerful living area and kitchen complete with gourmet appliances, comfortable furniture, colorful backsplash, and a fireplace. The kitchen is fully equipped to prepare meals and features bar seating for 8. Access to the pool and outdoor entertaining space is just outside the French doors, bringing in plenty of natural light. Upstairs, you'll find a balcony that overlooks Winston Lane and includes an additional seating area. There are also 2 guest rooms down the hall (both king suites) and a bunk room. Bright pops of color and artwork are seen throughout the bedrooms, with their own bathrooms and flat-screen TVs. The bunk room features 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds and a flat-screen TV. The third floor contains a primary suite featuring a king bed, flat-screen TV, and en-suite bathroom. The balcony in the bedroom is the perfect place to sip coffee in the morning.Guests will love the privacy and amenities featured with this cottage! 4 adult bikes are included, making it even easier to get to the beach or cruise around 30A. Don't miss your chance to stay at this vibrant home!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo- Bunk Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunkbeds THIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate*it is possible that your rental property may share a courtyard or lot with a carriage house or main house that is owner-occupied or rented to separate guests from your party.Garage is not for guest use.
